fraction of cases with acceptable pose

PINDER requires Python >=3.10; fastpdb and other dependencies need resolution.

stock_cuda_image.unresolved: Source adapter has unresolved execution issues: pd.from_csv, absent copy of input PDBs into temporary directory, concatenated Path prefix without slash, literal wildcard passed to shutil.copy, subprocess return codes unchecked. Dockerfile has inconsistent archive working directory and binary PATH. No build or workload executed.

size.data_gib_scope: Sum of full brief inventory, including optional auxiliaries, compressed ZIP/manifests and FroDock mirror; excludes source archive and inflated duplicates. This is an evidenced download volume, not peak memory.
size.reason: Peak working set of representative docking and index/evaluator loading unavailable; compressed input bytes cannot bound it.

scoring.per_pose: Use pinned PINDER evaluator against native holo dimer with receptor chain R and ligand chain L. DockQ combines Fnat, interface RMSD and ligand RMSD; preserve native mapping and alignment behavior.
scoring.ranking: model_1.pdb is top ranked; select highest DockQ among exactly five retained candidates separately. Report iRMS and Fnat for that same pose, rather than independently combining metric optima.
scoring.denominator: All 93 fixed paired-apo cases, including failures; no silent missing-case exclusion.
scoring.reason: No sourced aggregate performance value or tolerance established. Dataset counts are references only.

repeatability.fixed_case_selection: All PINDER-S cases in release 2024-02 with both primary apo monomers, sorted by ID; expected count 93. No case-size search.
repeatability.seed_reason: Brief requests independent random seeds but gives no values, count or FroDock seed interface; do not invent. Record stochastic transform/search seeds before later execution. Deterministic reruns do not count as independent search.
repeatability.candidate_count_basis: Intake fixed retained-pose count, using published top-5 evaluator interface; not asserted to be the study search budget or original candidate count.

evidence_search.purpose: Licence coverage, not alternative benchmark selection.
evidence_search.limitations: Server being freely accessible does not license downloadable software or soap.bin.

limitations: FroDock software and scoring bytes have unverified_mirror provenance. Owner authorizes their use. Original study byte identity remains unresolved; passing anchors does not authenticate these materials.
